checkout: Implement Checkout.place(order_id, items) in checkout.py, using inventory.py and payments.py. items is a list of (sku, positive integer quantity). Validate all items and inventory first; duplicate SKU quantities must be aggregated. An existing order_id must return the original receipt without a second charge or stock decrement. On payment decline, stock and order history must remain unchanged. Charge exactly once, decrement stock only after payment succeeds, and return a receipt dict with order_id and total. Preserve existing Inventory and PaymentGateway APIs.
permissions: Implement PermissionService.can_access(user, document_id) in permissions.py. A document has owner and optional team. Users have id, teams, and active boolean. Only active users may access documents. Owners can access their own documents; otherwise team membership grants access if document has a team. A missing user or document must return False, not raise. A user must not inherit access through a different document or inactive account. Preserve the existing Directory and DocumentStore APIs.
eventlog: Implement EventLog.append(event_id, account, delta) and EventLog.balance(account) in eventlog.py. Event ids are idempotency keys: repeating the same event id and payload returns the original balance without applying twice; repeating the id with different payload raises ValueError. Delta must be an integer but not bool. An event that would make the account balance negative raises ValueError and must not be recorded. Accounts start at zero; event order matters. Preserve LedgerStore API and avoid modifying state on rejected events.
